metadata.short_desc: Let QQ bots display a custom menu
metadata.desc: Configure custom menu entries in AstrBot WebUI and sync them to the QQ official bot. Private chat only.

language.hint: Supports zh-CN, en-US, ru-RU and ja-JP; only affects plugin logs, user-authored menu entries are not translated.

primary_color.hint: Primary accent color for plugin views in #RRGGBB format; also configurable on the Settings page.

secondary_color.hint: Secondary accent color for plugin views in #RRGGBB format; also configurable on the Settings page.

sync_menu.hint: When disabled, the plugin only reads the current private-chat menu and does not overwrite it.

qq_platforms.hint: This page keeps the legacy global config. Use Robots in the plugin view for per-robot setup. AppIDs not managed there can still use these credentials.

menu.hint: The legacy global private-chat menu remains editable here. AppIDs managed by Robots no longer use it. Up to 10 top-level items and 5 children per sub-menu.

parent.hint: Leave empty for a top-level menu; set to a Sub-menu entry name to attach this item to it.

link.hint: QQ requires https://; missing schemes are normalized to https:// automatically.

parent.hint: Leave empty for a top-level menu; set to a Sub-menu entry name to attach this item to it.

switch_id.hint: The switch state is included in message ext after the user toggles it.

dashboard.title: Custom Menu
dashboard.description: Maintain the QQ official bot private-chat menu in AstrBot WebUI, inspect sync state and trigger a sync.

logs.title: Logs
logs.subtitle: Watch plugin logs in real time. The latest 1000 entries from this process are kept in memory.

logs.noMatches: No logs match the current filters.
logs.empty: No logs yet. Waiting for plugin output.

logs.mockHint: Local dev environment: showing mock logs, not connected to the AstrBot backend.
